items.title: Anne Phillips interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 24, 2025
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Did you ever work with Joe Wilder? [INTERVIEWEE] Oh yes. ... See those were the people that were around and playing record dates, all those greatest.

ctx.x: percussion section George Devin said, “I’m not selling.” And I’ll tell you one of the great things, I mean there was so much friend and camaraderie on it. I was doing a session, I contracted the voices for — oh come on, come on, okay I’ll get it in a minute, but nevertheless the voices were in the booth and in the connecting booth was the artist who was Sammy Davis Junior. And this was Claus Ogerman, there we are. And Claus had his hands up in the air and I’m in the booth with my hands up ready to cue the singers…
That’s terrific. Did you ever work with Joe Wilder?
